title: I Am Not Them: Fluid Identities and Persistent Out-group Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with and without specific cultural personas (individualistic vs. collectivistic) across Western and Eastern languages, and measuring their agreement with validated individualism and collectivism survey questions using a Likert scale.

Administering political compass survey questions to evaluate liberal versus conservative values, comparing the models' default responses to those generated when assigned explicit Democratic or Republican personas.
